action.description: file: move it to destination. review: leave it for a person.

destination.description: Folder path relative to ~/Documents, using / separators, e.g. "Taxes/2025". Never absolute, never inside Inbox. null when action is review.

filename.description: A descriptive filename without extension, used only when rename_allowed is true. null otherwise.

confidence.description: How sure you are that destination is where this document belongs.

summary.description: One sentence: what the document is.

reason.description: One sentence: why this destination, citing the rule that applies.

new_folder_rationale.description: Why no existing folder fits, when destination does not exist yet. null otherwise.
